meta.title: DelugeRPG Trainers, Gym Leaders & Skills Database
meta.description: Complete DelugeRPG database containing Gym Leaders (Kanto through Sinnoh) and training NPCs with exact 4-move skillsets, base powers (damages), attack types, categories, variant mechanics, and solo-sweeper counters.

Normal.name: Normal
Normal.description: The standard baseline Pokemon. Reliable, standard stats with zero weaknesses to ability suppression.

Shiny.name: Shiny
Shiny.description: Distinctive alternate color palette with 25% extra base health for superior defensive survivability.

Metallic.name: Metallic
Metallic.description: Completely immune to Burn, Freeze, Paralysis, Poison, Sleep, and Confusion status effects.

Ghostly.name: Ghostly
Ghostly.description: Carries an inherent chance to cause the opposing Pokemon to flinch and forfeit its turn upon being attacked.

Shadow.name: Shadow
Shadow.description: Bypasses and disables the protective immunities of Metallic and Ghostly opposing Pokemon.

Dark.name: Dark
Dark.description: Fierce offensive variant dealing 25% extra base damage on all physical and special attack skills.

Mirage.name: Mirage
Mirage.description: Dynamically adapts based on opposing variant; gains defensive resilience and tactical reflection against variants.

Chrome.name: Chrome
Chrome.specialAbility: +35% HP Boost & High Critical Strike Damage
Chrome.description: Elite top-tier variant featuring 35% extra HP and amplified critical strike multipliers. The ultimate solo-sweeper pick.

Negative.name: Negative
Negative.description: High-contrast inverted color palette variant favored for visual prestige.

Retro.name: Retro
Retro.description: Faithfully styled classic Game Boy / vintage sprite appearance.
